quotes.speaker: Saddiq Bey
quotes.summary_phrase: Saddiq Bey praises Zion Williamson's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: he's leading the league in steals now and just what you see from him on that end
quotes.quote: He's doing a great job, playing with a lot of effort, instincts, IQ both ends of the floor. He's been doing a great job. I've seen this since last year to the summer to now. He's made a lot of great leaps and blessed to be having him as a teammate.

quotes.speaker: Saddiq Bey
quotes.summary_phrase: Saddiq Bey on the growth and poise of CJ McCollum
quotes.excerpt: his poise from last year to this year is on another level.
quotes.quote: The first week I came back from the summer, I told him his poise from last year to this year is on another level. So, he's been doing a great job with the ball in his hands and being a point guard, getting people involved, defending, and sky's the limit for him, man. He's doing a great job.
quotes.social_post: Saddiq Bey says CJ McCollum's poise is on another level this season, noting his growth as a playmaker and defender.

quotes.speaker: Saddiq Bey
quotes.summary_phrase: Saddiq Bey on maintaining focus during the regular season
quotes.excerpt: 82 games long season can't get too high, too low.
quotes.quote: It feels good. You can't dwell on the past. We got to focus on Memphis next. 82 games long season can't get too high, too low, and just continue to try to hone in on our system and what it takes to win and make that as consistent as possible.
quotes.social_post: Saddiq Bey on the Pelicans mindset early in the season: You cannot dwell on the past and you cannot get too high or too low during an 82 game season.

structured.context: Saddiq Bey explains the importance of maintaining focus and consistency throughout the long NBA season.
